title: NetDerivationRefusedPayload
description: Payload of the NetDerivationRefused event: canonical-svc refuses a net derivation that submission-svc requested (INV-REQ-558). It holds identifiers only. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

originalDocUuid.description: The Doc UUID of the original document whose net derivation is refused.

requestEventId.description: The CloudEvents id of the NetDerivationRequested event that is answered.

reason.description: Why the derivation is refused. NOT_A_CREDIT_NOTE, OTHER_ENTITY and CURRENCY_MISMATCH name an invalid credit note: NOT_A_CREDIT_NOTE a named document that is not a credit note, OTHER_ENTITY a credit note of another entity, CURRENCY_MISMATCH a different currency or exchange rate or SGD totals stated on one side only. NOT_PRECEDING: a credit note whose precedingDocUuid is not the original. BASE_CHANGED: a base version that differs from the expected one. DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND: an unknown original or credit note version. NET_NOT_POSITIVE: a net whose total is not above zero or that has a tax code group below zero.
